tools.name: tree
tools.description: List the files and direct subfolders of one folder at the base sha. Use only to discover which files exist; to find where text lives use grep without file. Returns `folder/: name, name/, ...`.

path.description: Folder relative to the repo root, no leading slash, e.g. "public/js".

tools.name: outline
tools.description: Structure of one file without its body: tags/ids/classes, CSS selectors, JS exports/imports, linked css/js. Use before reading a large file to pick a line window; not for exact lines (use read_file).

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Find keywords. With file: returns numbered line windows around the matches in that file. Without file: returns the files under path that contain any keyword. Use to locate the lines to edit; do not use to read a whole file.

words.description: Keywords, case-insensitive, any one may match, e.g. ["login", "signup"].

file.description: Optional repo-relative file to search in, e.g. "public/index.html".

path.description: Optional folder to list matching files in when file is absent; default "public".

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read an allowed file of this subtask from the current draft, with `Lnn| ` line prefixes for edit_file. Without start_line/end_line returns the head plus the total line count and how to continue. Do not re-read a window you already have.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the target (or listed) file, e.g. "public/index.html".

tools.name: read_skill_resource
tools.description: Read one file under references/ of an active skill. Use only when the skill body names that file; scripts/ is never readable or run.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Change the draft of an allowed file. Each edit is {after_line, insert} (insert after that line; 0 = top) or {search, replace} (search copied verbatim from the file). Line numbers follow the current draft. Returns the new line count.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the target (or listed) file, e.g. "public/index.html".

tools.name: write_test
tools.description: Set the one test file (ESM node:test) for this subtask; calling it again replaces the earlier test. The test must import or name the target file.

test.description: Full file text of the test.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Run a named check on the current draft in a network-less sandbox. light = syntax/lint of changed files; platform = repo-wide checks; relevant = the written Node test. Takes no shell/argv.

tools.name: request_package
tools.description: Ask the admin to approve an npm package you need. The run pauses until a decision; a rejection comes back as `denied: <reason>`. Never edit package.json yourself. Use only when no existing code can do it.

reason.description: One sentence: what the subtask needs it for.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Ask to read one external documentation URL. The run pauses until the admin decides; a rejection comes back as `denied: <reason>`. Use only when the repo has no answer.

reason.description: One sentence: what you need to learn from it.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Propose finishing after edit_file and write_test; the harness checks, then passes to the next gates. Rejected before an edit and a test.
